sloka: ध्रुवमद्यैव संहृष्टा लब्धलक्षाः प्लवङ्गमाः।आरोक्ष्यन्ति हि दुर्गाणि लङ्काद्वाराणि सर्वशः ।। ६.६८.१६ ।।
transliteration: dhruvamadyaiva saṁhṛṣṭā labdhalakṣāḥ plavaṅgamāḥ।ārokṣyanti hi durgāṇi laṅkādvārāṇi sarvaśaḥ ।। 6.68.16 ।।

translations.english: "Having found an opportunity, all the Vanaras, highly rejoiced, on this very day, will surely climb over the gates of forts of Lanka determined."
